i1.title: Street Origins Oars and Yours, Venice Extrait de Parfum 75ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Sea air and bergamot over black pepper and geranium, with vetiver and cedar.

Street Origins Oars and Yours, Venice Extrait de Parfum 75ml is a fresh, aquatic-woody fragrance. Sea notes and bergamot open brightly, a heart of black pepper and geranium follows, and it settles on a polished base of patchouli, vetiver and cedar.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Sea Notes, Bergamot
  • Heart: Black Pepper, Geranium
  • Base: Patchouli, Vetiver, Cedar

Key details

  • Brand: Street Origins
  • Concentration: Extrait de Parfum
  • Size: 75ml
  • Scent profile: Aquatic · Aromatic · Woody
  • Wear: Unisex

Why you'll love it

  • A breezy opening of sea notes and bergamot
  • A peppery heart of black pepper and geranium
  • A polished base of patchouli, vetiver and cedar
  • Long-lasting extrait concentration

FAQ

What does Oars and Yours, Venice smell like?

Sea notes and bergamot first, then black pepper and geranium, finishing with patchouli, vetiver and cedar.

Is it unisex?

Yes, it is made for everyone.
